corrections.reason: The canonical Ge'ez noun for 'partakers/fellowship' is ሱታፌ (5th order ፌ), which is clearly visible in the image (the bottom ring of ፌ was misread as the top loop of ፎ).
This quotes Verse 5 (ኦ ፡ እኀየ ፡ እሙን ፡ ግብር ፡ ዘገበርከ); the vocative ኦ (7th order) is printed on the page.
The Amharic word is ስለዚህም (with 6th order ህ, not 1st order ሀ).
Across the line wrap (L19-L20), the word is ተሁት (contracted form of ተውሁት, 'I left it'), with 1st order ተ clearly visible at the end of Line 19.
As in Line 19-20, the printed word is ተሁት ('I left it', from ተወ), with 1st order ተ rather than 6th order ት.
The distributive prefix in በየስማቸው ('by each of their names') uses 1st order የ, which is clearly printed without a 5th-order ring.
